title.en: Similarities between Early Domestication and Urban Faunal Usage
title.hi: Similarities between Early Domestication and Urban Faunal Usage

rows.en: Both early domestication and urban centres like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro relied on animals for meat, dairy, and traction.
rows.hi: Both early domestication and urban centres like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro relied on animals for meat, dairy, and traction.

rows.en: Both required selective culling, fodder strategies, and herd security, visible from Mehrgarh to Dholavira.
rows.hi: Both required selective culling, fodder strategies, and herd security, visible from Mehrgarh to Dholavira.

clarification.en: Taming involves modifying the behavior of a single wild animal during its lifetime, whereas domestication is a multi-generational process of genetic and morphological modification under human control.
clarification.hi: Taming involves modifying the behavior of a single wild animal during its lifetime, whereas domestication is a multi-generational process of genetic and morphological modification under human control.

relationship.en: Initial domestication primarily for meat transitioned into utilizing animals for milk, wool, and traction.
relationship.hi: Initial domestication primarily for meat transitioned into utilizing animals for milk, wool, and traction.
